title: PO↔BIZ-001: Product Roadmap + Market Requirement Updates
description: Product Owner/TPM provides product backlog/roadmap timeline, engineering velocity/release forecasts, feature-completion status for GTM, and escalation of scope changes with business impact; Business Consultant provides business-value ranking, market-window analysis, GTM-readiness inputs, customer-feedback synthesis, and market-requirement change notifications. Grounded in PRODUCT_OWNER_TECHNICAL_PROJECT_MANAGER_SKILL §6.15 and BUSINESS_CONSULTANT_SKILL §6.1. (Note: PO §6 lists Business Consultant twice — §6.13 and §6.15; §6.15 is the fuller, HR-2-tagged version used here.)

market_requirement_change.description: Significant market-requirement change (≤2 business days to notify).

product_impact_due_date.description: PO product-impact assessment due within 5 business days.

x-macp.tier_rationale: Routine product-market coordination (weekly/monthly cadence) is agent-autonomous. GTM-readiness inputs feed the Tier-1 PO↔ALL-RELEASE-001 gate at release time.
x-macp.cadence: TRIGGER (Weekly Business-Product Sync Mondays; Monthly Alignment Review; market-requirement change notified ≤2 business days, PO impact assessment ≤5 business days; GTM readiness review 2 weeks before release)
confirm_conditions: product_roadmap carries a roadmap_version and current backlog/forecast status
business_value_ranking present with at least revenue_impact per ranked feature
a market_requirement_change carries notified_date and a product_impact_due_date
gtm_readiness signals provided ahead of the Release GTM Readiness Review
reject_conditions: market_requirement_change reported without a product_impact_due_date (SLA unhonored)
GTM readiness asserted (pricing/sales/certification) without the underlying status
scope change with business impact not escalated to BIZ
counter_conditions: business-value ranking conflicts with engineering capacity — request joint re-prioritization at sprint planning
market-window date conflicts with the release forecast — request a GTM/timeline trade discussion
